'''''T-WF''''' was a [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] the tug was present among 4 [[Class-A cargo container]]s [[Koss (Class-A cargo container)|''Koss'']] that was protected by a small [[Mine Type A|minefield]]. A single [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] was sent to clear the minefield, when the mines were cleared the fighter inspected the containers to find one of them carrying equipment and destroyed the tug before it could enter a space container.
